comments.author: gcanyon
comments.story: Gene drive modified mosquitoes offer new tool for malaria elimination efforts
comments.why: Background on gene drive mosquitoes circulating for years.
comments.text: The idea of using gene drive on mosquitoes has been circulating for at least 8 years. [1] In that time, something like 4 million people have died of malaria, many millions more have been infected, and it is significantly impacting the economic growth of Africa. What will it take for us to pull the trigger on this? 1. [VIDEO]

comments.author: chasil
comments.story: Results from first US trial of genetically modified mosquitoes
comments.why: Explains gene drive as a targeted approach against a species.
comments.text: The introduction of an invasive species can have an overall beneficial effect if carefully evaluated, and there is a lot that can go wrong. [LINK] It appears that a "gene drive" was introduced into the Florida Keys in this case, and that is much more targeted and specific to a species that it is intended to destroy. [VIDEO]
